scope: EXT-D-0084 and EXT-D-0086 native Settings storage acceptance in an owned disposable Chrome profile
prepared_cases: Port rejected storage write preserves prior value, shows error, retries, and survives reload
Two port saves hold the first write and persist the later submitted value after reload
Held initial port read preserves a later edit and settles before its save
Pair-code rejected storage write preserves entered input and retries with a synthetic fixture code
Two pair-code saves hold the first write and preserve the later input and persisted value
Pair-code removal rejected write and retry only when the real UI offers Forget under HTTP transport
Local reset rejected clear keeps confirmation and prior storage, then retry clears storage and signs out
audience: Guest, member, and admin are parameterized through the shared native Settings authentication driver; each mode still needs its own runtime result.

passed_bounded_cases: Port saved through trusted UI, rejected write with error and retry, persisted after reload
Port writes submitted while first held complete in order with latest value after reload
Delayed initial port read preserves user edit and settles before write
Pair save rejection and retry, then overlapping synthetic pair saves preserve newest input and persisted value
Rejected local reset leaves dialog open and all seven prior local and one session key/value fingerprints unchanged
native_evidence.failed_boundary: Successful reset retry after reload: prior local-key comparison found two identical unexplained overlaps among seven prior keys; one session fixture was removed. Safe key-name diagnostic is prepared.

limits: Guest runtime results are partial, not defect closure. Member and admin have not run.
The storage fault helper wraps the panel Chrome API in an owned profile. It cannot establish a healthy desktop engine, actual pairing acceptance, or actual rediscovery.
Pair-code clear is marked unverified when native or disconnected transport hides Forget; a synthetic stored code alone does not make the HTTP-only control applicable.
The imported artifact belongs to the D84/D86 repair source but is an interim CI development build, not a published Store release.
next: Run the authorized reset-census-only guest diagnostic once to identify the two overlap key names without values; compare with source reinitialization, then decide whether reset has a product defect. Member/admin and real desktop connection remain separate later coverage.
